title: CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Edible Oils, Gold, Silver & Areca Nuts w.e.f. 1st Sep 2026
content:
# CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Edible Oils, Gold, Silver & Areca Nuts w.e.f. 1st Sep 2026

Ek important update hai! Government ne edible oils, gold, silver, aur areca nuts ke liye Customs Tariff Values revise kiye hain. Yeh changes 1st September 2026 se effective honge.

*   **What's New:** The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne Notification No. 72/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated August 31, 2026, issue kiya hai.
*   **Key Revisions:**
    *   Tariff values for various edible oils (like crude palm oil, RBD palm oil, other palm oil, crude palmolein, RBD palmolein, other palmolein, crude soya bean oil) have been updated.
    *   Gold ke tariff values mein bhi changes kiye gaye hain.
    *   Brass scrap ke tariff values bhi revise hue hain.
    *   For silver and areca nuts, the tariff values *unchanged* rakhe gaye hain.
*   **Effective Date:** Yeh revised values 1st September 2026 se લાગુ honge.
*   **Background:** Yeh notification Customs Act, 1962 ke sub-section (2) of section 14 ke powers exercise karte hue issue kiya gaya hai. Isse Notification No. 36/2001-Customs (N.T.) ko amend kiya gaya hai.
